recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, monochromatic cinematic portrait of a man integrated into a stone-like bust, set against a glowing triangular backdrop with heavy grit, cracks, and high-contrast lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a glowing geometric pyramid
Textured stone surface applied to both subject and typography
Radial light rays emanating from behind the central figure
Symmetrical composition anchored by a heavy stone pedestal
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and dust texture overlays
Cracked stone displacement on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-style portrait occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A solid rectangular stone base at the bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the pyramid lines downward to the main title, then rests on the pedestal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured outer corners with subtle architectural columns framing the edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and navy blue for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool white and light grey for highlights and glowing rays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone slate blue for texture mid-tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the central glow and dark periphery.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses sharp, vertical Fraktur-inspired strokes with 3D beveling
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, thin geometric capitals
All text features heavy stone-chip textures and cracks
characterSpecificRedesigns: V-shaped characters in the pedestal text are stylized as chevrons
Main title glyphs have exaggerated vertical height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ornate, dense Gothic display type with clean, minimalist geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, vertical Gothic aesthetic of the main title.
Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric contrast for the pedestal.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, monochromatic blue-grey portrait of a man with short dark hair. Apply a cracked stone texture to his skin. Place him in front of a glowing white pyramid against a dark, dusty background with radial light rays. Include a stone pedestal at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add 3D beveled Gothic text across the chest area with a stone texture. Add wide-spaced geometric sans-serif text engraved into the bottom stone pedestal.

verificationChecks: Text appears as part of the stone environment
Lighting rays align with the pyramid edges
Texture is consistent across skin and stone elements

adjustableVariables: Brightness of the radial light rays
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or artist monograms at the top
Unique facial features of the specific individual

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of stone texture on organic forms

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light source direction
Ensure the pyramid glow doesn't wash out the face
Verify the stone pedestal looks grounded and heavy
Confirm the blackletter text has a tangible 3D depth
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Central Portrait] + [Geometric Glow Backdrop] + [Stone Texture Overlay] + [3D Gothic Display Type] + [Engraved Pedestal Base] within a [Monochromatic Cool Palette].
